verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents official client libraries for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go or any other language, nor says how current they are. The only nearby items are a bare 'Search UI Components' heading, which is not language SDK coverage. There is also a community remark that Meilisearch, not Typesense, maintains a top-of-the-line Rails integration. An SDK ecosystem is a fair question for a search engine, but nothing here shows Typesense delivers it.
